mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 950K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 950K units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 7.0% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) shows a 3-month average increase of over 150K, a tightening labor market boosts productivity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both trigger conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average, indicating supply chain disruptions, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical impact of supply disruptions on equity markets
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.05 over any 1-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns during disruptions are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) growth exceeding 3.5% YoY, signaling robust demand, boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 30% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 3.5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increasing above 1.5% within a 3-month window, indicating monetary tightening, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical impact of rate hikes on equity markets
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS surpasses 1.5% within a 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on signal: the labor market's inherent momentum, as measured by the 6-month moving average of payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth, positively influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When both the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) and housing starts (HOUST) are above their respective 3-month moving averages, indicating synchronized demand growth, S&P 500 forward returns are positively influenced over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 45% of instances when both trigger conditions are met.
